# Gameflow project instructions

- This is a Vite + React single-page PWA for tracking games.
- Keep the UI mobile-first and usable at iPhone widths.
- Game decisions are persisted in `localStorage` under `gameflow-decisions`.
- The catalog intentionally stores one canonical record per game and lists available platforms on that record; do not add platform-specific duplicates.
- Prefer the existing visual language: dark charcoal background, warm orange accent, lime success accent, Manrope and DM Mono typography.
- Use `npm run build` to verify production output and `npm run lint` for lint checks.
